text: The melody haunted every character's story, a lingering reminder of the lullaby that once brought them peace. It appeared in the most unexpected places—a whistler in the street, a distant radio, the chime of a bell. The motif of the melody tied their stories together, underscoring the shared experiences that knit the fabric of the community. Just as the heart pumps blood to sustain life, this recurring tune pumped rhythm into the veins of the neighborhood, ensuring that no one felt entirely alone in their silence.
